about_the_game:
Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge is a casual single-player experience. Chill, enjoy the immersive 3D environments and complete a fine selection of your favourite puzzles. How would that feel solving puzzles generated from your own photos? Search no further and try it out now in the My Photos DLC.

With this DLC, you can import your own photos and solve procedurally generated puzzles, based on your own images.

After purchase, a new button will be displayed above the image selection menu. Simply click on the "My Photos" button and browse among your own images. Once you find your favourite photo, choose from 5 difficulty settings and Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge procedurally generates a puzzle to solve, in any environment you already have.

Features

generate your own photos into puzzles to solve

new, exclusive environment - English Cottage



enhanced camera movement
  • find small details easily


made in Unreal Engine 5
  • cozy, realistic, colorful and immersive full 3D environments
  • real-time physics, powered by Chaos Physics
    • light-weight physics simulation solution used in Fortnite
